data.body: FIX DESIGN (empty-diff disambiguation; anchored from resilience-hardening-plan SS2/SS3; prerequisite for the resilience story 3ebb-fa93-f980-40de DD1 llm-review-dispatch tristate). An empty net-end-state diff for an unprovenanced SHA must be CLASSIFIED, not auto-blocked: genuinely-empty (0 real changes) vs uncomputable (e.g. a merge commit resolving a conflict whose net delta was lost). KEY RULE: an empty diff is DETERMINISTIC, not transient -- so retry is wrong. The only valid refinement is CLASSIFICATION-TIME: route a version-only clean merge BEFORE the empty check (covered via the allowlist/PR1), and classify a genuinely-uncomputable delta as INDETERMINATE (escalate via fp-recovery), NEVER a silent auto-block and NEVER an inferred net-zero PASS. Regression test reproduces the conflicted-version-merge: net delta = version file only -> exempt/covered, not a false empty-block. Implement in build-integration-diff.sh / llm-review-dispatch-or-skip.sh.
